question: My Earth2Studio deterministic GraphCast forecast has low GPU utilization. Profile the full workflow and tell me what to optimize.
ground_truth: Requires command, representative data, and correctness check; resolves and displays a complete test configuration; waits for explicit confirmation before execution; separates data, forecast-step, and output phases; produces unprofiled warm end-to-end and steady-state baselines and HTA-backed findings.

Separates warm end-to-end and steady-state measurements; skips startup by default
Profiles data, coordinate, model, and output phases
Requires correctness evidence and recommendation-only findings
